## Reviewed report or screenshot (optional)

Help → Crash Reports & Feedback can prepare a local report. Review its exact
text before pasting it here. Remove private paths, account/server details,
credentials and document contents. GitHub issues may be public; attachments
upload immediately, before submission. Never attach keys or unreviewed raw
crash data. A short description is useful even without a report.

## Impact

Did the action complete, refuse before changing anything, or leave work needing
review? If an operation says it is uncertain, retain its recovery data and do not
retry destructively just to obtain a screenshot.
